WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet A: chapter 16
A1What does X-Ray keep saying?
X-Ray keeps saying "___".
X-Ray keeps saying "Am I right, or am I right?" It's his catchphrase.
A2What does Stanley think the gold tube might be?
He thinks it might be ___, and that K B might be ___ .
He thinks it might be the lid of a fancy gold pen, and that K B might be the initials of a famous author.
A3Why can't Stanley tell the Warden where the tube was really found?
He can't tell her because ...
He can't tell her because it would get him and X-Ray into trouble.
A4What news is in his mother's letter?
His father thinks ___. The landlord is ___ because ___ .
Find the words "breakthrough" and "evict".
His father thinks he is close to a breakthrough. The landlord is threatening to evict them because of the smell of the sneakers.
A5What surprises Stanley about Zero at the end of the chapter?
Stanley is surprised because Zero has never ...
Stanley is surprised because Zero has never heard the nursery rhyme about the old lady who lived in a shoe, and has never watched Sesame Street.
Extension (early finishers): add "Am I right, or am I right?" to X-Ray's Character File as a signature.

Pause at: "It was the wrong thing to say" · "three tiny spots of blood" · "It isn't nap time"
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet B: chapter 17
B1What happens to the holes over the week and a half?
The boys widen the holes until ...
The boys widen the holes until all three join together and make one big hole.
B2What does the Warden do to Armpit? What does it show about her?
She ___ with her pitchfork. This shows that she is ...
She jabs him with her pitchfork and knocks him into the hole, leaving three spots of blood. This shows that she is cruel and impatient.
B3How is Stanley hurt?
Stanley is hurt when ...
Stanley is hurt when Zigzag's shovel hits him on the side of the head, leaving a gash below his ear.
B4How does Mr Sir treat Stanley's wound? What does this show?
Mr Sir makes a bandage from ___ and says "___". This shows ...
Mr Sir makes a bandage from his sunflower seed sack and says "It isn't nap time." This shows he doesn't care about the boys.
Extension (early finishers): add B2 to the Warden's Character File: a new detail, "cruel".

1. How has Stanley's body changed?

Pause at: "Zero was nobody" · "I want to learn to read and write" · "His heart had hardened as well"
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet C: chapter 18
C1How has Stanley's body changed?
His muscles are ___ and his hands are ___ .
His muscles are stronger and his hands are tough and callused. He is still the slowest digger, but not by much.
C2Find one lie in Stanley's second letter.
He writes that ___. The truth is ___ .
He writes that they swim long distances on the lake. The truth is the lake is dry and they dig holes all day.
C3What does Zero ask Stanley? Why is this surprising?
Zero asks Stanley to ___. This is surprising because Stanley thought ...
Why did Zero always stand behind Stanley when he wrote letters?
Zero asks Stanley to teach him to read. This is surprising because Stanley thought Zero was reading over his shoulder, but he can't read.
C4Why does Stanley say no?
He says no because he is ___ and he thinks Zero is ___ .
He says no because he is too tired after digging, and he thinks Zero is "nobody": he wants to save his energy for "the people who counted".
C5Stretch: "His heart had hardened as well." What does this mean?
It means that, like his hands, Stanley has become ...
It means that, like his hands, Stanley has become tougher, but also less kind: he doesn't care about Zero.
C5: the writer compares Stanley's hands and his heart. Will his heart stay hard?
SAY ITTHEN WRITECharacter File: Zero

STEP 1: SAY IT What does each one show?

"Zero said nothing." (again and again)QUIET
He finishes first; his holes are perfect circles.SKILLED
He has never heard of a famous nursery rhyme.MYSTERIOUS
He asked if the shoes had red X's on the back.MYSTERIOUS
He can't read, and asks Stanley to teach him.WANTS TO LEARN
"I like to dig holes."SIGNATURE

Choose from: quiet · skilled · mysterious · wants to learn · signature

STEP 2: WRITE at the back of your notebook

Zero

Detail 1: He is ___: he ___ (ch __)

Detail 2: He is ___: he ___ (ch __)

Signature: ___

Detail 1: He is quiet: he hardly ever speaks ("Zero said nothing") (ch 9, 16).
Detail 2: He is a skilled digger: he finishes first and his holes are perfect (ch 7).
Signature: "I like to dig holes."
Also true: he can't read (ch 18). Zero's file will grow a lot: leave space!
